To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have isolated and sequenced a new 14 kDa cuticular protein from Locusta migratoria and found a central region of the protein with a (Tyr) - Ala - Ala - Pro - Ala/Val sequence motif.
the amino acid sequence of the 14 kDa cuticle protein from Locusta migratoria is similar to the amino acid sequence previously determined for a 15 kDa protein from the migratory locusta.

the primary structure of the 14 kDa cuticular structural protein Lm- 76 from the locust, L. migratoria, has been determined and the sequence shows high homology to other locust proteins of the same size and to the 14 kDA protein from the house cricket, Acheta domestica.
In summary, our research is concerned with
structural proteins of the locust cuticle and the elucidation of their amino acid sequences.
the structure of a protein isolated from the pheromone gland of the migratory grasshopper, Melanoplus sanguinipes (MSP-1), and its homologous protein from the locust Locusta migratoria (LM-76).
the structure of proteins from locust cuticle, which may have a potential as a new source of bioactive compounds.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the protein belongs to a family of structural proteins, which is characterized by the (Tyr)-Alanine motif.
protein Lm-77 belongs to the group of the cuticular proteins of the exocuticle.
protein Lm- 76 belongs to the family of the cuticular structural proteins.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the primary structure of protein Lm76 is highly similar to the primary structure of a 15 kDa protein from the pharates of L. migratoria and the 15 kDa structural protein from the pheromone gland of the male silkworm, Bombyx mori.
Lm-76 belongs to a class of proteins which are characterized by their high content of alanines, the absence of cysteines and their repetitive nature.
Lm-76 belongs to the group of structural proteins with a central hydrophilicity region surrounded by hydrophobic regions and that it has a high content of the amino acids alanine and glycine.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the sequence of the 14 kDa protein is similar to that of the 14-15 kDa proteins from the locusts Locusta migratoria (LM-14) and Schistocerca gregaria (SG-14) and to the 15 kDa proteins of the grasshopper Chorthippus parallelus and the cricket Acheta domesticus.
the amino acid sequence of the protein is highly similar to those of proteins from other insect species, and that the protein is likely to be an exocuticle protein.
protein Lm- 76 has a high content of tyrosine residues (10%) located in a repetitive sequence motif.
